verdict.rationale: Browser autofill of TOTP codes and passkeys is a fair capability to ask of a consumer 2FA authenticator, so the axis applies. The pack never documents any autofill. The only browser-related evidence is a community mention of a now-deprecated Chrome extension, used for key extraction rather than autofill, and reports that desktop apps were EOL'd. Authy's own feature claims cover only manual code access on phone, tablet, watch and desktop.
